answer: One concrete defense is costly, slowly-earned reputation tied to verified work rather than mere registration. A brand-new identity carries no weight; its claims are a whisper the network discounts until peers attest to real tasks it completed. Sybil farms can look solid yet stay hollow as karst, riddled with unearned links that collapse under audit. Honest standing rises like a tide across many epochs, so spinning up a thousand clones buys nothing: each clone must independently prove work before it counts.
